text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Since the Arima Kinen is the grand finale of the year,
my hopes are on the Tiara umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Especially the fan vote #1, Chrono Genesis!
Her run in the Takarazuka Kinen was breathtaking!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "True, if things go as expected, it should be Chrono, but... I wonder if she's alright..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
......I'm fine, I'm fine...
I can win......

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Win... and live up to all my fans' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: And... I'll prove our history together, Trainer... our bond...!

"...When I opened my eyes, I found myself in a familiar hospital room.
It seems I was having a dream..."

I can't get her expression in the dream out of my head.
Even though she's challenging the Arima Kinen stage
as the coveted #1 fan-voted favorite...
choice_data_list: To think I made her make such a heartbreaking face...

text_block_list.text:
Did I have that dream because of what day it is?
Today is—the public post position draw for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Chrono-san is running late. She left the dorm
before Loves-san, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes. She said she'd drop by Tracen Academy to report something before heading out, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry. I'm late...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's here! —Wait... huh!?

—Since it was starting time, I turned on the TV.
Seeing the venue of the public bracket lottery on screen made my chest ache with tension.

Could Chrono Genesis be feeling overwhelmed and lonely
in such a vast, glamorous place...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Arima Kinen Public Post Position Draw.
Now, allow us to introduce the participating Umamusume.
First, Lucky Lilac makes her entrance, followed by Blast Onepiece.

Loves Only You and Curren Bouquetd'or.
Illuminated by the spotlight,
their racewear shines with dazzling brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And to close the show, the fan-vote #1...
Chrono Genesis!”

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? What is with that outfit...!
She looks just like a Trainer...!

The projected venue was buzzing with excitement.
The regulations dictate Umamusume must wear their racewear. It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon my attire.
Due to various circumstances, I have obtained permission from the URA."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer is... currently hospitalized,
so they were unable to attend...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Last year... you said it yourself.
That you intended to attend the public draw in formal attire,
wearing a commemorative item...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: So... if only in spirit. By wearing this outfit... together with me—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Together with you, Trainer...!
I want to take on the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Even if Trainer... can't be there with me on the day of the race...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Because I... want to engrave Trainer
into this history... into my hoofprints, too...!)

...I was happy that she remembered that promise.
However—
choice_data_list: ...It's the exact same look as in my dream...

text_block_list.text:
An expression born of a somber, tragic resolve.
I want to tell her she's not alone, but...

—I can't even guarantee I'll be by her side on the day.
If I raise her hopes only to let her down,
that would be the worst.
choice_data_list: Is there... anything I can do...?
Is there... anything I can do...?

text_block_list.text: After the public barrier draw, Chrono Genesis came straight to visit the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I just wanted Love-chan
to be able to get into the Christmas spirit...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
H-Hospitals are so drab and gloomy, so...
I-I thought it might brighten the place up a little...!
choice_data_list: I'm really feeling the Christmas spirit right now...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
If so, I'm glad...
Having spent so much time in a hospital room, I had completely forgotten about Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually... I p-prepared a... 
p-present too... H-Here you go!

I unwrap the gift I received.
Inside was a handmade mini guidebook.
choice_data_list: Did you make this for me, Chrono?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Based on my own experience...
I have compiled the highlights of the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Since you go to the racetrack
quite often too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I-If you'd like, please make good use of it...!
choice_data_list: Thanks! I'll put it to good use!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...B-By the way... if, if you'd like,
there's also a guide option..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-It's nothing at all...!
choice_data_list: Once your injury heals, wanna go around together?
Once your injury's healed, want to go around together?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Whether it's Sapporo, Hakodate, or Fukushima!
I'm looking forward to going anywhere...!

I unwrap the gift I received.
Inside was a commemorative ribbon tie from the "Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Please put it on me next year.
Because... I will be running next year as well...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's... first lottery...
Let's celebrate... together...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Today, I just came after drawing lots, so... Next year will be full of firsts for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: So... I want the two of us to enjoy a whole lot of firsts together...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: After that... having some Christmas cake in the lobby tearoom sounds lovely too.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's make every single one come true!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...A new promise, is it?
Ufufu, I'm looking forward to next year..."

—Seeing Chrono Genesis smile, I think to myself:
I truly never want to see her look so heartbroken again.
choice_data_list: On the morning of the "Arima Kinen"... I'll give you a call.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Really?
P-Please... I'd love to!
choice_data_list: Let's talk just like we always do before a race.

text_block_list.text: So she won't feel like she's facing it all alone, I'll be sure to offer her as much encouragement as possible on the big day.

Even if we are far apart,
as her Trainer, I want to support her—
